prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman standing.

a warm olive complexion, late 20s goddess, powerlifter physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an enormous, overwhelmingly powerful woman; colossal thick trapezius muscle rising high around her neck, massive round boulder shoulders, enormous thick arms with dense hard muscle, a broad powerful back, a deeply carved abdomen, colossal glutes and hips extending far beyond the shoulders, gigantic quadriceps with a deep sweep; her head looks small on top of her massive frame; not slim, not a fitness body, powerful and heavy at once; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, top bun natural black hair — wearing a tight cropped sleeveless deep burgundy velvet zip-front top with a high collar, a chrome front zipper unzipped from the collar all the way down to her belly button where the chrome slider rests at her navel, the two zipper edges with their metal teeth running in a long deep V along her sternum and stomach, each side of the top covering one breast, paired with a deep burgundy velvet micro-mini skirt with its hem at the very top of her thighs, fully opaque and covering only what it must, her midriff bare below the zipper. Her right leg wears a sheer black thigh-high stocking with a wide lace top band and a dark seam running up the back, hugging her right thigh, knee, calf and ankle and running down into her heel, her warm olive skin faintly visible through the sheer nylon, matching the rest of her body. Her left leg wears a glossy deep-red latex thigh-high stocking with a thin elastic top band, stretched over her left thigh, knee, calf and ankle with mirror shine and fine pull-creases at the knee, completely opaque and running down into her heel. Pose: strong hip pop right, both hands pressing sides of hips outward simultaneously arching back to extreme — most extreme powerlifter silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, platform stiletto ballet boots made of deep burgundy velvet, each with a razor-thin tapered heel taller than her entire shin from ankle to knee and a towering hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, almond nails each longer than her middle finger, in glossy deep burgundy lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: heavy gold rings on every finger, a wide gold waist chain resting over the carved curve of her hips, and large drop earrings of mixed metals, a long silver chain ending in a heavy gold anvil-shaped weight on each ear, hanging above her collarbones. Jewelry is metal and pearl only.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Middle Eastern woman with large dark eyes, strong arched brows and a straight nose, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: slender upswept willow-leaf brows, a fine red floral huadian mark painted on the forehead, softly flushed rosy cheeks, an upswept eyeliner tail, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a small vivid red lip.

Background: a bright white-sand beach at midday with calm turquoise water, a wooden boardwalk with a waist-high rail and a row of closed striped cabanas of normal door height, in clear sunny daylight, bright and evenly lit, shadows soft, the whole floor and surroundings clearly visible and in focus, NO dark background NO black void. ONE woman only. Extreme macro detail on the fabric texture, the skin and the shadows. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the whole figure from the soles of the boots to the top of her head completely visible, with the door, railing or steps beside her at normal human scale so the extreme heel height reads at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the boot soles from the floor. 8K portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
